market_view: Calm regime: VIX 14.9 and falling, Nasdaq at a record on an AI rally, 10-year yield about 5.0%, oil fell 4.5% on Monday. Big sector moves already happened and are priced in.

oil_gas.catalyst: none: 'ExxonMobil Nears a Venezuela Return After 19 Years' (Yahoo) is only early-stage consideration, ~4% upside to targets
oil_gas.reasoning: Oil -4.5% yesterday is priced in; JPMorgan admits nobody knows the oil path (CNBC). Venezuela item is vague and slow. No one-sided XOM catalyst.

gold_miners.catalyst: none: only exploration news and technical-setup articles; no NEM guidance
gold_miners.reasoning: Gold below its 200-day average, yields near highs, dollar up. Headlines are noise or technical-screen pieces. No NEM-specific catalyst.

chips.catalyst: none: Meta Muse AI rally (ChartMill) already priced after semis +4% and AMD +10% in a day; Alibaba chip and data-center opposition are mixed
chips.reasoning: NVDA +7.8% in 5 days; the AI rally is priced. Cheap-valuation and Zacks rank articles are not events. Competing Alibaba chip and data-center opposition offset.

pharma.catalyst: weak candidate: 'Eli Lilly CEO Dave Ricks: 70% of new Medicare GLP-1 patients on Lilly drugs' (Yahoo), but it restates known Medicare coverage since July and is not a new event
pharma.reasoning: Medicare GLP-1 uptake is incremental information, likely partly priced after a stock down 7% in 20 days. No trial, approval or pricing shock. Too thin for a long.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none: 'Freeport-McMoRan's Low-Cost Secret to Take Advantage of Record Copper Prices' (Yahoo) is a promotional piece, no guidance or supply news
copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper +5.6% in 5 days and near high is priced. No FCX guidance, Grasberg or supply news. Uranium items concern CCJ and NXE, not the leader.

would_change_my_mind: An FCX guidance or supply shock, NVDA export or demand news, an LLY trial or pricing event, NEM guidance, or a clear XOM-specific deal or oil supply shock.

handoff.what_changed: Oil fell 4.5% Monday (XOM -3.2%) while Meta's Muse AI assistant sent the Nasdaq to a record and chips jumped (semis +4%, AMD +10%, NVDA +2.3%). VIX fell to 14.9. Copper rose 5.6% in 5 days. Lilly reported 700,000 seniors starting GLP-1 treatment under Medicare.

oil_gas.why: Oil drop is priced and the Venezuela return for XOM is only a vague early-stage item.

gold_miners.why: Gold below its 200-day average with yields near highs; no NEM guidance.

chips.why: AI rally already in the price after a 5-day surge; no NVDA-specific demand or export catalyst.

pharma.why: LLY Medicare GLP-1 uptake is incremental, not a trial, approval or pricing event.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX guidance or supply news; copper near highs after a 5-day rise.
